sentences.text: Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) conducted an eight-month review with Jade Pritchard (S2), mother of children Mason and Lily.
Children Mason and Lily are present during the visit; Mason is described as 'obsessed' with fire engines, and Lily is currently down for the day.
Jade Pritchard (S2) is the primary carer, working Monday to Friday on lorries, leaving her alone with the children during the week.
Jade Pritchard's mother lives on Thornfield Road and provides childcare support, specifically looking after Mason on Tuesdays.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) stated confidentiality rules: discussions remain between the health visitor, the mother, and the GP unless safety is concerned, in which case the
Lily's weight was recorded as 8.4 kg during the visit; her previous weight was 7.9 kg.
Lily is currently eight months old, wearing nine to twelve month clothes, and is following her expected growth line.
Lily is sitting on her own and is attempting to crawl, though she tends to go backwards.
Jade Pritchard (S2) reports Lily's feeding is 'good', with porridge in the morning, mashed veg at dinner, and four bottles daily (seven ounces each, sometimes not finishing the one
Jade Pritchard (S2) reports Lily is trying finger foods (toast, banana) but gags occasionally, which she finds worrying.
Jade Pritchard (S2) reports Lily sleeps for about seven hours and wakes once around three o'clock for a bottle.
Jade Pritchard (S2) reports Lily's hearing and eyesight are normal, noting that Lily turns round when Mason screams.
Jade Pritchard (S2) reports her mood is 'alright' but describes herself as 'tired' and 'bored', particularly in the evenings.
Jade Pritchard (S2) admits to drinking alcohol, stating she has 'a bottle of wine a night' on 'most nights' after the children are in bed.
Jade Pritchard (S2) admits to smoking 'a couple of nights a week' of 'weed' (a 'joint or two'), which she smokes in the garden/out the back door when the children are in bed.
Jade Pritchard (S2) denies ever using cocaine, stating 'No. Never. I've never done coke, not once, I wouldn.'
Jade Pritchard (S2) disclosed that she has fallen asleep on the sofa while caring for the children, and on one occasion, she did not hear Lily crying until Mason woke her up.
Jade Pritchard (S2) could not confirm the duration of time Lily was crying before Mason woke her up.
Jade Pritchard (S2) stated she would not drive if one of the children woke up poorly at 2 am.
Jade Pritchard (S2) denied that children's social care was taking her children.
Jade Pritchard (S2) reports her financial situation is 'tight', relying on Universal Credit and money sent by her husband Dean, with electricity costs having increased due to a key
Jade Pritchard (S2) agreed to stop drinking and stop using weed on nights she is alone with the children.
Jade Pritchard (S2) agreed to arrange for her mother to stay over on Wednesdays and Thursdays to provide childcare support.
Jade Pritchard (S2) confirmed that Lily always sleeps in her cot and never on the sofa, even if the mother has had a drink.
Jade Pritchard (S2) agreed to text her mother tonight to arrange the Wednesday and Thursday childcare.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) agreed to refer Jade Pritchard (S2) to the Harbridge Recovery Hub and write to Dr Anand at Elm Street surgery.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) agreed to ring Jade Pritchard (S2) the following day after speaking to her safeguarding lead.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) agreed to return to see Jade Pritchard (S2) on the eighth of December to review progress.
